ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth, 14 1/2 ounces
low-sodium red kidney beans, 15 ounces each

steps.instruction: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a 12-inch pan over medium heat.
Add 1 cup of onion pieces to the pan.
steps.spoken: Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pieces begin to soften but not brown.

steps.instruction: Dice 1 cup of green bell pepper into 1/4-inch pieces.
steps.spoken: Dice 1 cup of green bell pepper into pieces about 1/4 inch in size. Slice it into 1/4-inch strips, hold the strips together, and cut across.

steps.instruction: Add the pepper to the onion and cover the pan.
steps.spoken: Add the pepper to the onion and cover the pan. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.instruction: Add 1 tablespoon of garlic, 1 1/2 teaspoons of cumin and 1 1/2 teaspoons of oregano.
Add 1 can of broth and 1/2 cup of instant brown rice.
steps.spoken: Add 1 can of broth and 1/2 cup of instant brown rice. Stir well, cover the pan, and simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.instruction: Drain and rinse 2 cans of kidney beans thoroughly.
Add the beans to the pan.
steps.spoken: Stir well and cover the pan. Simmer for 5 minutes to heat the beans and blend the flavors.
